rolling dough by hand (not pin) is better. Leaves more air in and rises better. Yes, you can use flower but better is corn meal (taste) to keep the dough from sticking to the table. Just work the soft part out from under so you have a smooth edge. Then stretch it out by hand  either on the table or in the air. Believe me I have done this more times than the guy in the video and a lot longer. It takes some practice but is worth it. Otherwise you might as well use a dough pro (hydraulic press)
